title: Public Wolf
description: Pet death messages are now public and broadcasted over the whole server!
body:
This plugin adds PPDMs (Public Pet Death Messages) to your server. By default, Minecraft hides or restricts pet deaths, but PublicWolf broadcasts them to the entire server, ensuring everyone can see when a beloved companion passes away.

✨ Features
- 📢 Global Broadcasts: Completely public pet death messages across the entire server.
  
- 🏹 Smart Attacker Detection: Displays exactly who killed the pet, including tracking down the shooter if they were sniped by an arrow.
  
- 🌋 Environmental Messages: The original death messages for natural causes (e.g., suffocating, drowning, flying into walls, or trying to swim in lava).
  
- ⚡ Lightweight & Async: Built with performance in mind using asynchronous processes that won't lag your server thread.

📦 Supported Versions & Platforms
Supported Versions: Works flawlessly on every version from 1.21 to 1.21.11.

Platform: Designed specifically for Paper or Purpur (Bukkit/Spigot compatible).
